name: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
description: The Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco comprise the de Young Museum in Golden Gate Park and the Legion of Honor in Lincoln Park. Together they house an encyclopedic collection spanning over 5,000 years of ancient and European art, American art, textiles, and more.
fullDescription: The Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco comprise the de Young Museum in Golden Gate Park and the Legion of Honor in Lincoln Park. Together they house an encyclopedic collection spanning over 5,000 years of ancient and European art, American art, textiles, and more.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free Saturdays: Free general admission for residents of the nine Bay Area counties
- Free First Tuesdays: Free general admission for everyone on the first Tuesday of each month
- Museums for All: Free general admission with an EBT or Medi-Cal card, plus a discounted $48 Museums for All family membership
- Youth 17 and under: Always free
- Veterans and active military: Free general admission with military ID
- Students with ID: $10; Seniors (65+): $22; Adults: $25 (de Young general admission)
- Access Days and a discounted Access membership for visitors with disabilities
howToGetIt: For Free Saturdays, reserve online and bring a driver's license or postmarked mail showing a Bay Area address. Show your EBT or Medi-Cal card or military ID at the ticketing desk (subject to availability). Free admission covers the permanent collection galleries; special exhibitions may cost extra.
address: 50 Hagiwara Tea Garden Drive, San Francisco, CA 94118 (de Young)
